name: Superpowers Marketplace
description: Curated catalog of Claude Code skills for pc1970/Project1

plugins.name: PDF Processing Skill
plugins.description: Extract text, tables, and metadata from PDF files. Supports multi-page documents and produces structured output suitable for further processing.
plugins.author: pc1970

commands.name: /pdf
commands.description: Parse a PDF file and extract its contents

plugins.name: Skills Endpoint
plugins.description: Exposes an HTTP endpoint that lists all installed skills and their metadata, enabling discovery and integration with external tooling.
plugins.author: pc1970

commands.name: /skills
commands.description: List all installed skills and their available commands

plugins.name: Currency Trading Platform
plugins.description: Provides real-time exchange rate lookups, trade simulation, and portfolio tracking for currency pairs.
plugins.author: pc1970

commands.name: /trade
commands.description: Simulate a currency trade and show projected outcome

commands.name: /rates
commands.description: Fetch current exchange rates for one or more currency pairs

plugins.name: UI Test Automation
plugins.description: Generate, run, and report on Selenium-based UI automation tests. Reads test definitions from the automationUITests directory.
plugins.author: pc1970

commands.name: /run-tests
commands.description: Execute the full UI automation test suite and display results

commands.name: /gen-test
commands.description: Generate a new UI test case from a natural-language description

plugins.name: Plugin Manager
plugins.description: Install, remove, update, and search skills directly from the Superpowers Marketplace without leaving your Claude Code session. Reads the marketplace catalog and manages your local skill registry.
plugins.author: pc1970

commands.name: /plugin install
commands.description: Install a skill from the marketplace by its ID (e.g. /plugin install pdf-processing)

commands.name: /plugin remove
commands.description: Uninstall a previously installed skill by its ID

commands.name: /plugin list
commands.description: List all skills currently installed in this session

commands.name: /plugin search
commands.description: Search the marketplace catalog by keyword, category, or tag

commands.name: /plugin update
commands.description: Update all installed skills to their latest versions

plugins.name: X Video Downloader
plugins.description: Download videos from X (formerly Twitter) posts. Supports multiple formats (mp4, webm, gif, HLS), automatic highest-quality selection, video clipping by time range, and CDP mode for accessing private tweets through an authenticated Chrome session.
plugins.author: RichardBray

commands.name: /x-dl <url>
commands.description: Download the video from an X/Twitter post URL

commands.name: /x-dl --url-only <url>
commands.description: Return the direct video URL without downloading

commands.name: /x-dl cdp <url>
commands.description: Download from a private tweet using an authenticated Chrome session (CDP mode)

commands.name: /x-dl --from <time> --to <time> <url>
commands.description: Download and clip the video to the specified time range (e.g. --from 00:30 --to 01:30)
